data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'manzura', meaning 'achievement, victory, triumph'. In Islamic culture, the name Manzurah symbolizes the attainment of success and spiritual growth through perseverance and determination. The name Manzurah carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manzurah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
